_commentaire: Presets de génération musicale Suno pour LucidityFM. 100% instrumental, jamais de voix (les voix cassent le focus). Chaque preset = un type d'ambiance deep work.

deep-focus-piano.style: ambient piano, soft warm pads, minimal, sparse, no drums
deep-focus-piano.ambiance: calme, introspectif — travail de fond, lecture, écriture

lofi-night-code.style: lofi hip hop, mellow, warm vinyl, soft beat, nocturnal
lofi-night-code.ambiance: cocon nocturne — coder tard, le pilier de la niche

ambient-rain-drone.style: ambient drone, atmospheric pads, gentle rain, no percussion, evolving

synthwave-focus.style: chillwave, warm analog synth, slow arpeggio, dreamy, retro
synthwave-focus.ambiance: momentum rétro-futuriste — garder de l'élan sans distraire

organic-nature-flow.style: organic ambient, nylon guitar, kalimba, soft field recording, warm

dark-focus-cinematic.style: dark ambient, cinematic pads, deep sub bass, slow, tense, brooding
dark-focus-cinematic.ambiance: intense, sérieux — mode lock in, guerrier

minimal-techno-engine.style: minimal techno, hypnotic, steady pulse, repetitive, deep, no vocals
minimal-techno-engine.ambiance: énergie soutenue — abattre du volume de tâches mécaniques
